0022600118.text: The Memphis Grizzlies (2-0) are in their third game of the season, visiting the Sacramento Kings (0-2). Memphis has won both games so far, is 1-0 on the road, and sits 2nd in the Southwest, 0.5 games back, and 5th in the West, while Sacramento has lost two straight, is 4th in the Pacific, 2 games back, and 14th in the West. Zach Edey is out for Memphis with an ankle injury, and Cedric Coward (wrist sprain) and Karim Lopez (knee bruise) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, while Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Memphis won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, though the Grizzlies lost the most recent meeting 123-114 in Memphis on February 23, 2026.
